builder.title: Dashboard builds
builder.waiting: The builder is waiting for you
builder.comment.placeholder: What to change: the builder carries on in the same branch
builder.confirm.accept: Merge “{title}” into {branch} and restart the dashboard?
builder.confirm.rollback: Roll back “{title}”? This makes a git revert commit and restarts the dashboard.
builder.confirm.reject: Reject “{title}”? The branch {branch} and its worktree will be deleted.
builder.restart_yourself.accepted: Accepted. Restart sya serve to load the new code
builder.restart_yourself.rolled_back: Rolled back. Restart sya serve to load the new code
builder.diff.title: Diff: {title}
builder.diff.truncated: The diff is large: showing the beginning.
builder.not_a_checkout: The dashboard isn’t running from a git checkout ({path}): there’s nowhere to build
builder.detached: The checkout has no current branch (detached HEAD): there would be nowhere to accept the build

builder.too_many.one: {n} build is already running: accept or reject it on the dashboard
builder.too_many.other: {n} builds are already running: accept or reject one on the dashboard

builder.not_ignored: {folder} isn’t in the checkout’s .gitignore: the worktree would become a change in it
builder.sync_failed: uv sync failed in the worktree: {output}
builder.wrong_status: The build’s status is {status}: this action isn’t available
builder.checkout_dirty: The checkout has uncommitted changes: {files}. Commit or remove them
builder.other_branch: The checkout is on the branch “{current}”, but the build started from “{base}”. Switch back
builder.moved: The branch has new commits since the checks: checking it again
builder.hidden_paths: The build changes paths a merge would overwrite silently: {paths}. These are files the checkout ignores, or Claude Code settings in .claude/. Ask the builder to take them out of the branch
builder.merge_failed: The merge didn’t work, the checkout is untouched: {error}
builder.sync_revert_failed: uv sync failed, and so did reverting the merge: {error}. Not restarting the dashboard
builder.sync_rolled_back: The build’s dependencies didn’t install (uv sync): the merge was rolled back
builder.sync_rolled_back_stale: The build’s dependencies didn’t install (uv sync): the merge was rolled back. Restoring the previous dependencies didn’t work either: run uv sync in the checkout yourself
builder.not_merged_here: This build’s merge isn’t in the checkout’s current branch: nothing to roll back
builder.revert_failed: git revert failed, the checkout is untouched: {error}
builder.not_ours: This build’s branch or folder wasn’t made by the builder: delete them yourself
builder.remove_failed: Couldn’t delete the branch or the worktree: {error}
builder.no_session: The build has no session: write to the builder in its chat
builder.comment_too_long: The text is longer than {max} characters
builder.error.no_commit: the builder ended its turn without a commit
builder.error.no_commit_said: the builder ended its turn without a commit: “{said}”
builder.error.not_tip: the build’s worktree isn’t on the last commit of {branch}: nothing to check
builder.error.uncommitted: the worktree has uncommitted changes: they won’t reach the dashboard
builder.error.sync_revert_failed: uv sync failed, and so did git revert
builder.error.sync_rolled_back: the build’s dependencies didn’t install (uv sync), the merge was rolled back
builder.error.sync_rolled_back_stale: the build’s dependencies didn’t install (uv sync), the merge was rolled back. Restoring the previous dependencies didn’t work either: run uv sync in the checkout yourself
builder.error.crashed: the new version crashed on start (code {code})
builder.error.no_answer: the new version didn’t answer in {n} s
builder.sandbox.missing: {path} isn’t there: not running the build’s code without a sandbox
builder.sandbox.no_port: The dashboard’s port for the sandbox is unknown ({port}): not running the build’s code
builder.tmp.foreign: {path} is someone else’s folder or a link: the builder’s sandbox needs its own
builder.tmp.too_long: The builder’s temp folder {path} is longer than {n} bytes
builder.preview.no_worktree: The build’s worktree isn’t on disk
builder.preview.no_answer: The preview didn’t come up: the server didn’t answer
